import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long bestNum = 0;
    static long bestDen = 1;

    static void update(long x, long y, long i) {
        long temp = (x * i) / y;
        long diff1 = x * i - temp * y;
        long diff2 = (temp + 1) * y - x * i;
        if (diff1 > diff2) temp += 1;
        long left = bestDen * (x * i - temp * y);
        long right = i * (x * bestDen - y * bestNum);
        if (Math.abs(left) < Math.abs(right)) {
            bestNum = temp;
            bestDen = i;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = scanner.nextLong();
        long y = scanner.nextLong();
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        long i = 1;
        do {
            update(x, y, i);
            ++i;
        } while (i <= n);
        System.out.println(bestNum + "/" + bestDen);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
